listing.name: NHL Legacy Edition — NHL Legacy Recomp (puckhead73)
listing.summary: The project reports playable features, but Portcove has not tested them. Proton use does not establish a native Linux player. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own supported unmodified Xbox 360 ISO or game folder. The builder checks default.xex and rejects other regions, modified files and title updates. This guide does not include the exact accepted region or hash; check the project’s builder requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the v0.6.0 release builder’s --iso or --from option to create the game locally. The Windows player uses native Vulkan. Linux and Steam Deck use Proton11; a native Linux player is not established.

warnings: The project reports playable features, but Portcove has not tested them. Proton use does not establish a native Linux player.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
